purpose: Teach: 申し込み/専攻/子会社/持ち主/一環/一括/圧縮/復旧

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察への、本気で、絶対、申し込み、絶対、件、絶対、ご対応、絶対、いたしました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: I want to express our sincere gratitude for your department's thorough handling of this matter.
lines.style: Measured and formal, professional warmth. Steady eye contact. Clear diction on key words. Respectful but not obsequious. The tone of someone used to official channels who still means what they say.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察関係者の、本気で、絶対、専攻、絶対、分野、絶対、専門的、絶対、ですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. It's clear your team has deep expertise in these kinds of cases.
lines.style: Warm acknowledgment with slight deference. Relaxed shoulders. Genuine appreciation, not performative. Nods slightly on the affirmation. The ease of two professionals understanding each other without ceremony.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 関連の、本気で、絶対、子会社、絶対、警察、絶対、捜査、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: As part of our broader crime prevention work, we've strengthened patrol coverage in the relevant areas.
lines.style: Steady, informative delivery. Slight formality but accessible. Controlled pace—not rushed. The voice of someone explaining procedure because it matters, not to impress.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。盗難品の、本気で、絶対、持ち主、絶対、警察、絶対、探されているそうですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: I understand the owner of the stolen items is being actively searched for by your department.
lines.style: Careful, respectful phrasing. Light check-in tone—seeking confirmation, not stating. Warm but measured. A slight uptick at the end, making it collaborative rather than interrogative.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 防犯対策の、本気で、絶対、一環、絶対、警察、絶対、巡回、絶対、強化しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: This patrol enhancement is one part of our comprehensive crime prevention strategy.
lines.style: Clear and methodical. Slight emphasis on the scope—'comprehensive'—without sounding defensive. Calm authority. The tone of someone explaining their work to someone who will understand its importance.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。情報、本気で、絶対、一括、絶対、警察様、絶対、共有、絶対、いたします、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We'll make sure all relevant information is shared with your department promptly and thoroughly.
lines.style: Assured and direct. Warm commitment underneath the professionalism. Slight nod on 'all'—conveying completeness. The promise of someone who follows through.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 証拠の、本気で、絶対、圧縮、絶対、保管、絶対、警察、絶対、徹底しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We maintain rigorous standards for evidence preservation and documentation.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. Steady, unhurried pace. The voice of someone for whom this isn't negotiable. Slight emphasis on 'rigorous'—not defensive, just clear about standards.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。災害時の、本気で、絶対、復旧、絶対、警察様、絶対、ご支援、絶対、いただきました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We're genuinely grateful for the invaluable support your department provided during the recovery efforts.
lines.style: Sincere closing warmth. Slower pace than the procedural lines. Slight breath before 'invaluable'—the pause of genuine feeling. The voice softens just slightly—honoring what was done, not just the procedure.
